subject: Control over multiple legends in ggtree

messages.author: f638ffb872db2564
messages.subject: Control over multiple legends in ggtree
parts:
I have a questions regarding a script which uses ggtree to plot a RAxML tree with support values, colors the tips according to the host of each taxon, and labels certain clades. Everything was working fine until I decided to annotate node using circles whose areas represent any support values that are > 50%. This created a second legend whose position and title I am unable to alter. 

Code:
```
## Plots tree and colors taxa according to host affinities

library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(phytools)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtree)
library(ggrepel)
library(treeio)

#specify clade names
clades <- data.frame(node = c(428, 282, 290, 365, 302, 323, 438), ids = c("PoEc","PoE3", "PoM", "PoE", "PoU3", "PoO/PoS", "Pu"), pos=rep(1, times=7))

#read in data
Tree1 <- read.tree("~/TreeDatafinalRAXML/RAxML_bipartitions.outSupport")

# define groups based on genus identifiers in tip labels
groupInfo <- split(Tree1$tip.label, gsub(".*_", "", Tree1$tip.label)) # split(x, f) split dataset x into groups defined by f
groupInfo <- lapply(groupInfo, function(x) gsub("_.*", "", x))        # apply function(x) to each element in each group

# strip genus info off tip labels
Tree1$tip.label <- gsub("_.*", "", Tree1$tip.label)

# assign group info in the tree object
Tree1 <- groupOTU(Tree1, groupInfo)

# plot and save the tree
pdf("Fig1_TreecladeLabelFanNoLengthBC.pdf", 22, 22)
ggtree(Tree1, 
       layout = "fan", 
       branch.length="none",
       aes(label = gsub(".*_", "", label))) +

       geom_tree(aes(color=group), show.legend = F) +
       geom_tiplab(aes(color = group, subset = grepl("UFVPY", label), label = gsub("UVFPY", "ufv", label)), size = 6, offset =3, show.legend = F) +
       geom_hilight(data=clades, mapping=aes(node=node), extendto=2.7, fill = "grey", color = "grey50", size = 0.05) +
       geom_cladelab(data=clades, mapping=aes(node=node, label = ids), align = T, offset = 0.5, angle = "auto", barsize=NA, horizontal=FALSE, hjust = 0.5, fontsize = 6, ) +
       
       geom_point2(aes(subset=!isTip & !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 50, size = as.numeric(label)/100)) +  # guilty aesthetic
  
       geom_polygon(aes(fill = group, x = 0, y = 0)) +  # plot invisible data to force new legend
       
       theme(legend.position="top",
       legend.text= element_text(size=20, face="italic"),
       legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size=24, face="bold"),
       legend.direction = "horizontal",
       legend.justification = c(0.5, 1),
       legend.background = element_rect(fill="white",size=0.3, linetype="solid",colour ="black")) +
       guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Species", nrow = 3, override.aes = list(label = "")))
dev.off()
```

Ideally I'd like full control over this legend as was the case with the first one. So, my first question is what is the best way to accomplish this?

Additional questions are as follows:

2. I cheated with the first legend by using show.legend=F in the geom_tree call and adding a non-plotted geom_polygon which enable me to access the group info. Is there a better way to accomplish the same result?
3. Is it possible to specify the plot order so that the bootstrap circles are on the top layer and not beneath the clade highlights?
4. Any other suggestions regarding code style?
